scenarios.title: Redeemed before Expiration
scenarios.description: A recovery token must be redeemed before it expires.

scenarios.title: Redeemed After Expiration
scenarios.description: The recovery token is rejected if redeemed after the tokens expiration.

scenarios.title: Redeemed Once
scenarios.description: An account recovery token may only be redeemed once.

scenarios.title: Account Recovery Token must Match
scenarios.description: The supplied account recovery token must match the hashed account recovery token.
